en.summary: Windows and Mac now share one release.
changes: Mac: generation with audio or mixed references works again, matching the fix in Windows v0.1.1.
Windows and Mac downloads now sit together on one release page, and each new version appears there as the latest release.

zh.summary: Windows 与 Mac 统一发布。
changes: Mac：修复音频及混合参考无法生成的问题（Windows 已在 v0.1.1 修复）。
Windows 与 Mac 安装包放在同一个正式版页面，每个新版本都会作为最新正式版发布。
